city.hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Closed 12:00 to 12:30 for lunch.

topics.words: pothole street road asphalt hole pavement patch curb
topics.window: Window 3, Service Garage, 40 South Market Street
topics.hours: Monday through Friday, 7:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.
topics.notes: Call before 2:00 p.m. if you want it on this week's patch list. After hours, leave the street and house number on the machine.

topics.words: birth death record certificate vital copy certified obituary
topics.hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
topics.notes: Bring a photo ID. Cash or check. City copies are the ones we keep here. County health still issues the state certificate.

topics.words: dog license pet rabies tag kennel
topics.hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
topics.notes: Need the rabies certificate. Tags are sold January through March at this window. After April 1 the county auditor sells them.

topics.words: water sewer bill utility leak meter shutoff
topics.hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
topics.notes: Bills mail on the first. Due the 20th. A leak on the street side of the meter is ours. A leak in the house is a plumber.

topics.words: building permit fence shed porch zoning addition garage
topics.hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
topics.notes: Bring a sketch with the lot lines. Fence height is four feet in the front yard, six in the back. Cash or check for the fee.

topics.words: trash garbage recycling bin missed pickup refuse
topics.hours: Monday through Friday, 7:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
topics.notes: Set cans at the curb by 6:00 a.m. If the truck missed you, call the same day. Extra bags need a sticker from the clerk window.

topics.words: parking ticket citation meter tow fine
topics.hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
topics.notes: Pay here or mail the envelope on the ticket. Do not bring the ticket to the clerk window. We cannot void it.

topics.hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
topics.notes: Both people need to come in. Photo ID and the $65 fee. We do not perform the ceremony here.

topics.problem: Tree or limb in the street
topics.words: tree limb branch down storm oak maple
topics.hours: Monday through Friday, 7:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.
topics.notes: A limb in the travel lane is ours. A tree on private property is the owner. After hours call the non-emergency police number on the card by the door.

topics.words: snow plow ice salt sidewalk storm
topics.hours: During a storm, the garage stays open until the main streets are clear.
topics.notes: We plow the numbered streets first, then the side streets. Do not shovel snow back into the road. Sidewalks in front of a house are the owner.

topics.problem: Copy of minutes or an ordinance
topics.hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
topics.notes: Plain copies are 25 cents a page. We do not certify them at this window. Ask if you need the stamped version.

topics.hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
topics.notes: The city form is due April 15. Withholding questions go here, not the county auditor.
